description: The upstream spec sends the draft content as `text/powershell`, but the converted model drops the media type, so the generated client JSON-encoded the string body: a runbook uploaded as `Start-Sleep 600` arrived as the string literal `"Start-Sleep 600"` (a PowerShell Workflow runbook was wrapped in an InlineScript that only echoed it). Send the body verbatim as `text/powershell`.
